label: SIM - Peru 148
info:
Simulation tab for Peru 148 RO Water Filtration.
Use the inject nodes to control update frequency.
See PLC Simulator function header for full documentation.

name: ⚙ FREQUENCY CONFIG  ─  A: edit '▶ 30s cycle' repeat field  ─  B: enable ⚡5s or 🐢300s (disable main first)  ─  C: click ▶ Manual for one-shot
info:
HOW TO CONFIGURE UPDATE FREQUENCY
══════════════════════════════════

OPTION A – change the main cycle rate (recommended)
  1. Double-click the '▶ 30s cycle (main)' inject node
  2. Change 'Repeat every __ seconds' to any value
     (5s = fast debug | 30s = default | 300s = real BL rate)
  3. Click Done → Deploy

OPTION B – use a preset inject
  Right-click '⚡ Fast: 5s'   → Enable   (disable ▶ 30s first)
  Right-click '🐢 Slow: 300s' → Enable   (disable ▶ 30s first)
  ⚠  Only ONE inject should run at a time.

OPTION C – one-shot manual tick
  Click the ■ button on the '▶ Manual trigger' inject node.

NOTE: All frequency settings survive a Deploy but are reset if
Node-RED restarts unless saved.

⚠  No azureiotdevice node is connected here. Output goes to debug nodes only.

name: Trends_filtration_060526  [SIM – read-only copy]
func:
const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

var globalKeyLookup = null;

function buildGlobalKeyLookup() {
  var lookup = {};

  if (typeof global.keys !== "function") {
    return lookup;
  }

  var keys = global.keys();

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var key = keys[i];
    var normalizedKey = key.toLowerCase();

    if (lookup[normalizedKey] === undefined) {
      lookup[normalizedKey] = key;
    }
  }

  return lookup;
}

function getGlobalValue(key) {
  var value = global.get(key);

  if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
    return value;
  }

  if (typeof key !== "string") {
    return null;
  }

  if (globalKeyLookup === null) {
    globalKeyLookup = buildGlobalKeyLookup();
  }

  var matchingKey = globalKeyLookup[key.toLowerCase()];

  if (matchingKey === undefined) {
    return null;
  }

  value = global.get(matchingKey);
  return value !== undefined && value !== null ? value : null;
}

function getFirst() {
  for (var i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) {
    var v = getGlobalValue(arguments[i]);
    if (v !== undefined && v !== null) return v;
  }
  return null;
}
